test_autograd_backward: test the gtn library backward pass on scalar graph addition and subtraction operations
test_forward_score_grad: test the gtn forward_score gradient computation on graphs with multiple start and accept nodes
test_viterbi_score_grad: test the gtn viterbi_score gradient computation on graphs with multiple paths and accept nodes
test_numerical_grad_check: test numerical gradient verification by perturbing arc weights and comparing analytical gradients
test_sample_grad: test the gtn sample operation gradient computation on graphs with self-loop arcs
